say:8:1826028007:1.text: For matters concerning the Syndicate, you can refer Salazer to Edward.
say:8:1826028007:1.source_cn: 若是黑金商会的事务，让他去询问爱德华即可。

say:9:1826028008:1.text: If the subject of Bantus comes up, just feign ignorance and have Vesperia answer in your place.

say:10:1826028009:1.text: When it comes to covering for Mother, no one does it better than her.

say:11:1826028010:1.text: But if he asks about Novaris' internal affairs, that is a rather more delicate matter...

say:12:1826028011:1.source_cn: 这些事，母亲大人向来亲力亲为，只是效率堪忧罢了。

say:14:1826028012:1.text: Nothing in this world runs true forever. But broadly stable? Yes, that will do.
